# **

🍬 Sweety Gap Counter

**

The Sweety Gap Counter is a custom Minecraft texture pack designed to provide a clean, intuitive, and fun way to track the number of golden apples in your inventory and on other players by transforming them into colorful candy items.

This pack is inspired by Quap Gapple Counter and builds on the same idea with a candy themed style instead of ducks.

Each candy color corresponds to a specific range of golden apple counts, offering a clear and immediate visual cue without the need to constantly check numbers. Whether you are in the heat of a PvP battle or exploring deep into survival mode, this pack adds both functionality and charm to your gameplay. The more golden apples you have, the more green the candy becomes. The fewer golden apples you have, the more red the candy looks.

![Preview2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dbcae67c1e3618a903b9eb66ae11922d243ba5e.png) # **✨ Features** - 🍬 Golden apples retextured into candy, varying in color based on quantity. - 🎨 Color-coded tiers help you recognize how many gaps you have at a glance. - 🧩 Minimalistic and modern design, tailored for competitive and casual players alike. - 🌐 Works seamlessly in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments. - 🚫 No messy or intrusive numbers, everything is visual, clean, and intuitive - 🔗 Inspired by [Quap-Gapple-Counter](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/quap-gapple-counter) ![Chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/653fd7b1733d8bec0e72f87a866dfa4edbe55c95.png) Perfect for players who enjoy a lightweight visual HUD replacement, the Sweety Gap Counter enhances your Minecraft experience with a touch of sweetness and clarity, without compromising your focus. _For further questions dm polar882 on discord_ For versions 1.21.3 and below, you will need either CIT Resewn or Optifine. For versions 1.21.4 and beyond, you can run this pack in vanilla minecraft. ![Preview1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed760fd8f7bb71eab3dc3318b5f096b5fe847a8d.png) ![Preview3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6de337c70c3814a6c640174bdfe01a6f9fcb4278.png) As you can see in the image above, the item is oriented in such a way that it's a lot easier to see the color of it.
